objectives_fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: piliin ang tamang lalapitan.
objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: choose the right contact.

sections.takeaway_fil: Hindi lahat ng katanungan ay para sa midwife o barangay officials — may mga bagay na ang kapwa BHW mismo ang may pinakamalapit na sagot.
sections.takeaway_en: Not every question is for the midwife or barangay officials — some things a fellow BHW is simply the closest person to answer.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang paglapit sa maling tao ay hindi lang nakakaubos ng oras — naaantala rin nito ang serbisyong dapat sana'y mabilis.
sections.takeaway_en: Approaching the wrong person doesn't just waste time — it also delays the service that should have been quick.

check.prompt_fil: Sino ang makatutulong sa karaniwang tanong tungkol sa pag-file ng ulat?
check.prompt_en: Who can help with an ordinary question about filing a report?

options.fil: Kapwa BHW na may karanasan, at ang supervisor kung kailangan.
options.en: An experienced fellow BHW, and the supervisor when needed.

check.feedback_fil: Kapwa BHW na may karanasan, at ang supervisor kung kailangan. Ipaliwanag ang dahilan gamit ang sitwasyon sa aralin.
check.feedback_en: An experienced fellow BHW, and the supervisor when needed. Explain why using the lesson situation.
